gates.evidence: Contract and browser decisive paths emit manifest/environment/raw-results/summary/logs/failure-cases/corpus-lock/negative-results bundles; full iteration logs are retained and manifest-hashed.
Flake exclusions require one predefined HARNESS_* reason code plus issue/expiry/exact signature; non-harness failures remain OUTCOME-FAILURE data.
Append-only negative-result registry retains falsified toolchain hypothesis plus P5 harness-invalid failures and their resolutions instead of deleting history.
The 13-case compatibility corpus is frozen by schema/date/count and content-addressed Git blob SHA; byte changes require a new corpus-lock version/change record.
Every assurance bundle file except the manifest is SHA-256 + byte-count bound; the verifier re-reads and hashes every file mechanically.
Ledger reconciliation/closure/partial counts, evidence-level counts, corpus rows and negative-result rows are computed from artifacts and rechecked by the verifier/tests.
Every ledger evidence key has explicit SOURCE/DOCUMENTATION/MODEL/LOCAL/UNIT/INTEGRATION/BROWSER/DEVICE/CROSS-BROWSER/RELEASE-VERIFIED/BLOCKED-HARNESS typing; preflight emits evidence-level counts.
BLOCKED-HARNESS is non-executable/non-closure-eligible and validator tests reject any attempt to mark it PASS or use it for closure.
SOURCE/DOCUMENTATION evidence is explicitly separate from EXECUTABLE evidence; closed critical gates backed by non-executable evidence cause a fatal preflight/registry failure.
Critical closure requires executable INTEGRATION-or-stronger evidence, so MODEL/LOCAL/UNIT-only claims must be reproduced before release closure.
Browser assurance environment records warmup, cache, CPU throttling, GC, thermal, network and DevTools validity conditions instead of hiding uncontrolled factors.
Stable preflight requires the exact 304 source gate IDs to be reconciled and all closed; a forged production_closed=true with an incomplete ledger remains REDESIGN.

boundaries: P18 governs evidence integrity; it does not upgrade SOURCE/DOCUMENTATION/LOCAL evidence for other domains.
DEVICE and CROSS-BROWSER evidence counts remain zero until real campaigns exist.
production_closed remains false until every source gate reaches its own required closure.
